notes.title: My Empire v2.1.0 Released
notes.content: My Empire has just been updated to v2.1.0, featuring bug fixes, as well as a new title screen and icon.  Thanks for playing!

notes.title: My Empire v2.0.0 Released
notes.content: My Empire on Steam has been updated to v2.0.0.  This update includes rendering fixes and a revamp of the title screen.  Enjoy!

notes.title: My Empire v1.2.0 Patch Released
notes.content:
The v1.2.0 patch for My Empire is now available.  This update adds a new rotate camera mode, and allows cities to put their production points towards Coins or Research.  See the full release notes below, thanks for playing, and stay tuned for more!
